description: This Java source file defines the ModifyAttributesResponse class, which is a specific type of response for the ModifyAttributes command within the Eclipse Ditto project. It encapsulates details about the outcome of the command, including the thing ID, attributes created or modified, HTTP status codes, and JSON serialization/deserialization methods.
